description: This file defines schemas and classes related to tool configurations for function calling adapters in the Pipecat framework, including support for standard and custom tools with different adapter types.

classes.name: AdapterType
classes.description: Enum representing supported adapter types for custom tools (GEMINI and SHIM).

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema class for managing standard and custom function calling tools, providing an interface for handling associated tools in the Pipecat framework.

methods.name: None __init__( self, standard_tools: List[FunctionSchema | DirectFunction], custom_tools: Optional[Dict[AdapterType, List[Dict[str, Any]]]] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes a ToolsSchema instance with lists of standard tools and optional custom tools, mapping tools to their schema representations.

methods.name: List[FunctionSchema] standard_tools(self)
methods.description: Property that returns the list of tools following the FunctionSchema format.

methods.name: Dict[AdapterType,List[Dict[str,Any]]] custom_tools(self)
methods.description: Property that returns the dictionary of custom tools mapped by adapter type.

methods.name: custom_tools (setter)
methods.description: Setter method to assign a new dictionary of custom tools.

methods.name: None custom_tools(self, value: Dict[AdapterType, List[Dict[str, Any]]])

ctags.name: GEMINI
ctags.pattern: /^    GEMINI = "gemini"  # that is the only service where we are able to add custom tools for now$/

ctags.name: SHIM
ctags.pattern: /^    SHIM = "shim"  # for use as backward compatibility shim for creating ToolsSchemas from list /

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, standard_tools: List[FunctionSchema | DirectFunction], custom_tools: Optional[Dict[AdapterType, List[Dict[str, Any]]]] = None, )

ctags.name: custom_tools
ctags.pattern: /^    def custom_tools(self, value: Dict[AdapterType, List[Dict[str, Any]]]) -> None:$/
